name: Risk factors

subjectOf.text: ICO sale terms are not fixed at launch: promoters can alter the smart contract to change the sales rules mid course during an offering, a risk factor for retail investors that has no analogue in a registered offering.
subjectOf.abstract: Promoters can also alter the smart contract to change ICO sales rules mid-course during an ICO.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
scope_conditions: ICOs administered through promoter controlled smart contracts

subjectOf.text: Only one in one hundred token opportunities returns a large multiple such as 100x, 30x or 10x, which Kaal lists as a core risk factor for running a DAO investment club.
subjectOf.abstract: Only 1 in 100 of token opportunities returns 100x, 30x, 10x
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

subjectOf.text: Without access to a network of core expertise, early stage investments in the digital asset industry are rarely successful.
subjectOf.abstract: Without access to a network of core expertise, early-stage investments in the digital asset industry are rarely successful
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098
scope_conditions: an industry that evolved in silos of information and expertise

subjectOf.text: ICOs that allowed their token to trade before the underlying product existed, at least in beta, created significant risk for investors because the product might never go live and the token could lose its value entirely.
subjectOf.abstract: ICOs that allowed their token to trade before the underlying product was built, at least in a beta version, create significant risk factors for the investors as the product may not go live at all and the token may lose its value entirely.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: token trading opens before a working or beta product exists
